content_fields.title: Integrate with SSO
content_fields.description: Federate authentication to the organization's single sign-on provider instead of holding local credentials.
content_fields.guidance: Authentication should be delegated to the corporate identity provider over OIDC, with the application consuming validated identity assertions, mapping provider groups to its roles, and retaining no local password store.
content_fields.found: The service maintains its own users table with locally hashed passwords and issues its own tokens; no identity provider integration exists.
content_fields.missing: A tenant in the identity provider, client registration, group-to-role mapping and a migration plan for existing local accounts.
content_fields.conclusion: SSO adoption is an organizational identity decision requiring provider onboarding and a credential migration, well beyond a change in this repository.
content_fields.action: The identity and access management team should decide on SSO adoption and provide the client registration this service would consume.
